data.title: About Olivia
bio: Olivia Mullane joined Green Light Realty in 2019 following a successful 15-year career as a public relations executive.  She became interested in real estate when she purchased her own dream house (through Green Light Realty! ), an historic home built before the Revolutionary War.  Following the birth of her son, she decided to pursue a new direction and focus on real estate full-time.

Olivia is dedicated to helping others find the house that will become a true home.  Olivia's interest in architecture and extensive background in marketing and communications gives her a unique advantage to help clients locate their new home or sell their current one.  Prior to her role at Green Light, she served as Partner at Finn Partners, a global, full-service marketing and communications company.  She graduated from Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey, with a BA in communications and art history.
She lives in Cranford with her husband, Michael, a Jersey City firefighter, and son, Brian.  Call Olivia today at 732. 277.
